accepts.because: one call of the model this hive serves: `messages[]` is the whole running round as it stands (the opening turn, the evidence pairs, every tool iteration so far), never history; `system` the per-round slots; `tool_scope` passes through; `hop.session_id`, `hop.turn_id`, `hop.iter` name the round. Answered by exactly one `brain`
durable system slots of the caller's own making (the tool menu, the sidecar contract): kept as the caller's slots and sent to the model with the next call whose system changed, never on their own

the tap: every output of the model this hive serves, raw, with its usage and the four keys the parent's edge promoted onto `brain` (`context.curator_call`, `context.session_id`, `context.turn_id`, `context.iter`); without a session it is session `default`, without a turn the round of its call. A final answer (`stop`, `length`) enters the ledger from here and from nowhere else; the usage fills the call record and a stamped `cache_expires_at` sets the clock. An output without `context.curator_call` is dropped and said

an identity pack: `system.{identity,persona,handover,instructions}` and nothing else, answered on `pack_ack` with the context passed through untouched. An unknown family refuses the whole pack (`slot_unknown`), an empty one is `pack_empty`
a closed session (`context.session_id`): answered by one `write` batch in the collector's close contract, empty when the session left nothing

a model package for `./summarizer`, pushed by the colony's llm-registry (GH #858): a params-only body the llm cell merges into its live params and answers with nothing; it goes from this path straight to that cell and past every other

emits.because: the call: `messages[]` the window, `system` only when a family changed (each changed family one `$replace` root), `tool_scope` unchanged, the hop of `in_curate` unchanged plus `curator_call`. The parent's edge onto the model promotes `curator_call`, `turn_id`, `session_id` and `iter` into context, so the tap comes back with them

one participant turn (the person's, the model's final answer, a peer's) for whoever keeps episodes, one per message, in the collector's per-turn contract: `hop.turn_id` `<session_id>#<index>`, `hop.turn_index`, `hop.happened_at`. Off with `./writer` `turn_write` = "0"
a closed session as ONE batch in the collector's close contract: `messages[]` the participant turns, `rounds` everything else raw, `hop.turn_count`/`hop.round_count`
the receipt of one pack: `hop.pack_owner`, `hop.pack_slots`, `hop.error_code` (empty, `slot_unknown`, `pack_empty`), `hop.pack_unknown`; the context of the pack rides on
a model package pushed through `in_model` that `./summarizer` refused (GH #863): its error, with the cell's own path in `hop.refused_subscriber`, leaves here for the registry's way back

description.purpose: Scope marker of the curator hive: the window of ONE model and the ledger of every call it got. THE HIVE IS THE ADDRESS -- everything from outside is sent to the hive path and the hive hands it on.
description.use_when: One per model whose window has to be owned: in front of a conversation brain, wired between the context collector and the `llm` cell. Nothing in the contract assumes a conversation -- any `llm` cell can sit behind it.
description.not_in_scope: No retrieval, no tool fan-out, no persona of its own, no policy per role. It keeps what the model saw and decides what it sees next; what is worth remembering is the memory's business.
description.contract_in: Six lanes on `hop.route`: in_curate, in_slots, in_llm, in_pack, in_close, in_model.
description.contract_out: Five routes on `hop.route`, leaving through the hive path: brain, turn_write, write, pack_ack, model_refused.
